proposed_widenings.name: persistent_area_save family
proposed_widenings.justification: Zone of Truth plants a persistent non-concentration area that evaluates each creature on first entry in a turn or on turn-start via a save gate. No existing spell family handles this pattern: activation fires a save once at cast; anchored_trigger releases a signal effect (not a save gate); ongoing_effect only carries roll_modifier or damage_on_hit operations.
proposed_widenings.evidence: a creature that enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Charisma saving throw

proposed_widenings.name: Condition: compelled_honesty (behavioral speech constraint)
proposed_widenings.justification: The effect on a failed save is a behavioral restriction on speech ('can't speak a deliberate lie while in the radius'). This is not any of the 14 standard SRD conditions. The current Condition type in types.ts only includes 'prone'. The constraint needs a new Condition variant or a dedicated effect atom distinct from apply_condition.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, a creature can't speak a deliberate lie while in the radius.

notes: Zone of Truth's core shape — persistent timed (non-concentration) area with per-creature entry/turn-start save that applies a behavioral condition for the spell's remaining duration — has no honest family match. The save_gate in the activation family fires once at cast against a fixed target selection; anchored_trigger supports only signal effects. Secondary mechanic: caster knowing each creature's save result is caller-owned notification per ARCHITECTURE.md and does not require a core atom. The behavioral constraint content ('no deliberate lie') is partially narrative, but the mechanical structure (save gate → condition applied → persists until creature leaves or spell expires) is real and warrants a new persistent_area_save family.
